GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (14 Nov 46) CCS
(SCAPIN-1337)
APO 500
14 November 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Application for Permission to Open Facsimile Telegraph Service.
1. Reference is made to letter from the Imperial Japanese Government, Central Liaison Office, C. L. O. number 5329 (CC), dated 11 October 1946, subject, “Application for Permission to Open Facsimile Telegraph Service.”
2. There is no objection to opening facsimile telegraph service on a commercial basis. This service is to be operated by the Ministry of Communications in accordance with the plans as outlined in inclosures to the letter referred to in paragraph 1 above. General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, shall be advised promptly of any changes in these plans.
3. Direct correspondence between Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the Ministry of Communications regarding technical matters within the scope of this memorandum is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
